value.rationale: The exact strong-reset position barrier and a globally strict ordering in the stable noise index give a complete qualitative design rule across a continuous continuum of transport exponents. The direction is opposite to the known trend in the weak-reset coefficient-of-variation region, clarifying a mathematically relevant difference between asymptotic protocols. Monotonicity and singular limits use a genuine nontrivial Euler-product proof; not a numerical parameter table or an unsupported finite-rate optimization.
